name: 60193 · Schaumburg, IL
findings: ZIP 60193 (Schaumburg) has 86 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (46% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60193 (Schaumburg) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 60193 (Schaumburg) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 42% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 50 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.
